title: Don’t expect money.
content: This game is nothing more than a money grab for the creators. You get pop up’s and ads every other minute, and the game is really not designed for you to win any significant money. If you put $5 in on a $30 pot, the winnings get split up among the top 4 people. So even if you win, you get $1 and lose the $5 you just put in. It’s a fail setup. This is a deceptive money grab just like all of the other games promising you an opportunity to make some money. Apple should do a better job about vetting these deceptive game creators, but apparently-they don’t care about their consumers any more than the creators do. This is nothing more than a waste of your time. They get paid off the ads you’re forced to watch every other minute. You get taken for a ride and a fool, and that’s the exchange.
